scripts.build: npm run build -w @loomrealm/game-launcher-pwa && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:qualification: npm run build -w @loomrealm-game/tile-presentation -w @loomrealm-game/map -w @loomrealm/game-launcher-pwa && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build.mjs --qualification
scripts.test:unit: node --test test/build-generation.test.mjs test/content-manifest.test.mjs test/data-broker.test.mjs test/provisioning-bridges.test.mjs test/service-worker-gate.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build:qualification && npm run test:unit && node scripts/run-e2e.mjs all
scripts.test:m16: npm run build:qualification && npm run test:unit && node scripts/run-e2e.mjs m16
scripts.test:m17: npm run build:qualification && npm run test:unit && node scripts/run-e2e.mjs m17
